rows.action:
Start automatic email flow to reschedule:

Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for letting us know you won't be able to attend your appointment this time.

You can easily choose a new time here:
[Rescheduling Link]

We’ll be happy to welcome you and support you in finding the best sofa configuration for your home.

Kind regards,
[Your Signature]
 
+ call ASAP.
rows.speech:
Call Speech:

Hi (Name), I'm glad that I managed to connect with you, I'm calling from Livom, my name is (Your Name). 

I just saw that you cancelled your appointment of today, thanks for letting us know! 

May I ask if you’re still interested in visiting us and it was just a matter of timing?

If yes: Nice, I can book for you a new appointment now if you like. Otherwise, you can also reschedule anytime through the link we sent you by email.

Thank you, and I remain at your disposal. Have a nice day!
rows.if_reply:
Try to reschedule. If new appointment booked → 
Before Showroom flow.
rows.if_no_reply: Send WhatsApp immediately after the call (see the 2nd template below), then step 2

[configuration link]

The next helpful step would be to check whether the size and layout still feel right for your room. If you would like, I can also prepare a final adjusted version before you decide.

Warm regards,
[Advisor Name]
